headline: WikiKnow Editor Has Been Defending Same Article for 15 Years; No One Knows Why
subheadline: User 'FactualGuardian847' has made 23,000 edits to entry about obscure 1970s synthesizer
summary: A WikiKnow editor's obsessive protection of a minor article has become an internet legend.
content:
Since 2009, WikiKnow user FactualGuardian847 has made over 23,000 edits to a single article: the entry for the Krohnberg KS-7, an obscure synthesizer manufactured in West Germany from 1974 to 1976.

No one knows why.

The KS-7 was produced in limited quantities and is primarily a footnote in synthesizer history. Yet FactualGuardian847 has dedicated 15 years to maintaining what is now the most comprehensively documented minor musical instrument on the internet.

"The article is 47,000 words long," noted WikiKnow administrator @EncyclopediaEnthusiast. "That's longer than our entry on World War II. It includes serial number registries, a complete list of every song that may have featured the KS-7, and a 3,000-word section on the specific type of wood used in the casing."

Attempts to edit the article—even to fix typos—are reverted within minutes. FactualGuardian847's edit summaries are terse: "Incorrect." "Citation needed." "See talk page." The talk page contains 847 archived discussions, most of which are FactualGuardian847 arguing with themselves.

"I tried to add a sentence about the KS-7's influence on ambient music," said user @SynthHead. "It was removed in 34 seconds with the note 'Unsubstantiated. The KS-7's influence on ambient music is complex and deserves its own section, which I am currently researching.' That was in 2017. The section hasn't appeared."

No one has identified FactualGuardian847. Theories range from "the last surviving Krohnberg engineer" to "someone who lost a loved one to a KS-7-related incident" to "a very dedicated bot."

The user's only other activity is occasional edits to articles about obscure German electronics companies, always reverting other users' changes.

When reached for comment via WikiKnow's messaging system, FactualGuardian847 responded: "The KS-7 deserves accuracy. I will continue until accuracy is achieved."

They did not specify what "achieved" means.
author: Marcus Webb, Internet Culture Correspondent
